title: Mushroom Blocks Optimization│蘑菇塊優化
description: A Mushroom Block will drop itself when broken, and can be broken down into Mushrooms.│蘑菇塊被破壞後會掉落自身，並且可以分解成蘑菇。
body:
# Function│功能
- ushroom Blocks and Mushroom Stems now drop themselves when broken.│M蘑菇方塊以及蘑菇柄在被破壞後會掉落自身。
- A Red Mushroom Block can be broken down into 2 Red Mushrooms│一個紅色蘑菇方塊可以分解成2個紅色蘑菇
- A Brown Bushroom Block can be broken down into 2 Brown Mushrooms│一個棕色蘑菇方塊可以分解成2個棕色蘑菇
